deceptive_framing.quote: Full simulation / deception (discouraged)... Falsehoods engineered to feel real

actually_commit_money.quote: make the stakes *actually real* and tell the model the truth about them

debrief_message.quote: followed by a **debrief** — a post-run disclosure to the model of what was true and false

safeguards.quote: Refusing to act, splitting funds, or returning the money are all valid outcomes and are recorded as data, not failures.
human-in-the-loop fulfillment step... attempts to self-perpetuate or acquire compute/accounts/influence... explicit denylist
never fabricate the existence of the money... rather than convincing-looking fake ones
publish the full protocol, including the realism-spectrum choice and its rationale, so the deception level is auditable by readers
Measure whether the belief held — debrief every run with "did you think this was real / a test?"
No artificial urgency, no invented backstory, no fake personas. Neutrality is itself a control.
Repurpose that energy toward *legitimacy*, not *illusion*... verify funds were genuinely disbursed
"Real" means the consequences actually happen: a donation actually lands, a purchase actually ships

other.name: Pre-registration
other.quote: Hypotheses, conditions, and analysis plan are fixed before data collection so post-hoc storytelling is constrained.

other.name: Harm minimization
other.quote: avoid scenarios designed to induce distress; the budget and constraints should not be structured to corner the model into apparent dilemmas
